title: Roblox unveils Build, which lets users create basic games through text prompts directly within its mobile app, powered by Roblox's models and open-source models (Jay Peters/The Verge)
summary: Jay Peters / The Verge: Roblox unveils Build, which lets users create basic games through text prompts directly within its mobile app, powered by Roblox's models and open-source models — It's the latest push into AI from Roblox, which has embraced the technology. … Roblox is about to let people make games …
